CustomField.description: Calculated deadline for speaker approval based on request type and event start date.
CustomField.formula: CASE( TEXT(Event__r.category__c), "One to One meeting", DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) + 1, "Meeting day(s)", DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) + 3, DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) + 5 )
CustomField.label: Approval Deadline
